info.title: CardV B2B API
info.description: Merchant API for CardV B2B virtual product supply chain. Every request sends X-Key-Id, X-Timestamp, X-Nonce and X-Signature; the signature is HMAC-SHA256 with the signing secret, which is shown once at key creation and never sent over the wire. See https://cardv.net/developers/authentication/.

get.description: Return API, database, and cache health status.

parameters.name: amount
parameters.description: Required for range SKUs. Must be between min_face_value and max_face_value and, when the SKU has an amount_step, a multiple of amount_step.

* `accepted` - Accepted
* `processing` - Processing
* `succeeded` - Succeeded
* `partially_succeeded` - Partially succeeded
* `failed` - Failed

max.description: Maximum local amount; equals min for fixed denominations.

operator_key.description: Pass this value to quote and order requests.

order_id.description: Public order ID (O-...). Use it for lookups.

external_order_id.description: Your unique reference; repeats return the existing order.

amount.description: Same local-currency amount as the quote.

local_currency.description: Optional ISO 4217 code of amount, same value as the quote.

account.description: Recipient phone number for the selected country, preferably with country code (e.g. 60123456789 or +60 12-345 6789); a national number is also accepted. It is normalized to E.164 digits; an invalid number returns 400 before any balance is debited. Returned only in masked form.

quote_token.description: quote_token from POST /recharge/quote, valid for 300 seconds.

merchant_price.description: Amount debited from your wallet, 4-decimal string.

quote_token.description: Signed token; send it unchanged when creating the order before expires_at.

local_currency.description: Optional ISO 4217 code of amount, from the operator's currency_codes.

MerchantKeyIdAuth.name: X-Key-Id
MerchantKeyIdAuth.description: Public API key ID (ck_live_... / ck_test_...). Every request must also carry X-Timestamp, X-Nonce and an X-Signature computed with the signing secret. See https://cardv.net/developers/authentication/.
